newsitem.title: SLOVAKIA: Slovak SKK 512.9 mln 96 net profit - TASR.
newsitem.headline: Slovak SKK 512.9 mln 96 net profit - TASR.

text.p: Slovakofarma a.s., Slovakia's largest drug maker, posted a 1996 net profit of 512.9 million crowns, the official Slovak TASR news agency reported on Monday.
Quoting a Slovakofarma spokesman, TASR said overall turnover at the firm for 1996 was 4.97 billion crowns, up from 4.34 billion crowns in 1995.
Company officials were not immediately available for comment.
Earlier this year Slovakofarma's Financial Director Helena Jandikova said the firm expected a 1996 net profit of around 500 million crowns compared to a 1995 net profit of 481.2 million crowns.
She said the company planned to pay a dividend of "around" 200 crowns per share for 1996, compared to 250 crowns per share from its 1995 result.

Slovakofarma shares have been one of the fastest rising issues on the unlisted market of the Bratislava Stock Exchange (BSE) closing at 4,251 crowns last Friday after trading around 3,600 crowns at the beginning of February.
TASR said the company's basic assets totalled 1.52 billion crowns at the end of 1996.
Brokers say the issue has potential to rise to around 5,000 crowns, but that low liquidity has hampered its development.
